Method of Attack: Embedding hidden login forms on sites to exploit browser login managers that autofill usernames and passwords, allowing extraction of usernames or emails without user authentication
Extracting username/email from hidden login fields, hashing them, and linking the hash to the visitor's advertising profile for tracking
Discoverer: Princeton Center for Information Technology Policy (CITP)
Impacted Systems: Browsers with vulnerable login managers (all major browsers except Brave at time of writing)
1,110 websites on Alexa Top 1 Million sites list
Attack Vector: Hidden login forms embedded by web trackers on websites
Browser autofill of login credentials into hidden fields
Indicators of Compromise: Scripts from audienceinsights.net (Adthink) and behavioralengine.com (OnAudience) found on 1,110 Alexa Top 1 Million sites
